Verifier executed successfully from the actual package path; no finite sampling is used as a proof of uniformity.

value.rationale: Classifying the exact good-reduction locus and the two inequivalent nonreduced special fibers of the natural Gévay–Pokora 12_3 line arrangement is a natural structural arithmetic-geometric invariant. Its odd-prime stability—including ramified characteristic seven—and the contrast between the two split dyadic reductions cannot be read off its published complex incidence counts. The divergence of reduced support genera from constant Cartier genus quantifies degeneration. Not asserted to give a model-independent or general group-theoretic theorem.
